scope: Uncommitted working tree on main at a41d482a (5 commits ahead of origin/main 2d8f8989); trustweave-saas excluded
rubric: Same six equally weighted categories as the 2026-09-05 assessment, so the numbers are comparable. Engineering judgement, not certification.

previous.note: That round executed no build or test run.

current.verdict: Not releasable as it stands; the GA core is close, gated by a red CI pipeline and five verified defects

why_it_moved.security_and_access_control: -1.0: two verified verification-logic defects in shipped protocol plugins (OpenID Federation chain key direction reversed and alg=none accepted; Verifiable Intent L3 tokens never checked for aud/nonce) plus round-13 findings 01 and 02 still open. Transport gating, signing enforcement and SHA-pinned actions are credited.
why_it_moved.observability_and_diagnosability: unchanged: 35 of 777 main-source files use a logger, 648 broad catches, 6 empty catches, no correlation or metrics guidance.
why_it_moved.reliability_and_scale: -1.0: this diff introduces a FileWallet listing failure for relative paths, a filter that throws mid-iteration, cloud listings that abort on a concurrent delete, and an O(N) statistics path; unbounded session stores remain in three sibling protocols.
why_it_moved.configuration_and_data: -0.5: stale ServiceLoader entries for optimism and zksync break anchor discovery for any classpath that includes them; the new deployment policy is enforced in three factories and bypassed by the fourth.
why_it_moved.deployment_and_release: +0.5: ABI validation, Kover, CycloneDX SBOM, mandatory signing and a provenance workflow now exist and the ABI check passes locally. Capped because CI on main has been red since 2026-08-23 (lint step fails before build), ktlintCheck fails locally with 218 violations in 13 files, the 105 ABI dump files are untracked, and no release has ever been published.
why_it_moved.testing_and_documentation: unchanged: the full suite was executed this time and is green (3790 tests, 0 failures, 15 skipped, 87 modules; wallet 70/70), but 26 modules with main code have no tests, the federation verifier has no positive-path test, and the checkout chain test was deleted rather than fixed.

blockers: B1 CI gate red since 2026-08-23: lint fails before build; 218 local ktlint violations in 13 files; none of the new ABI/coverage/SBOM steps has ever run in CI
B2 optimism and zksync META-INF/services still name org.trustweave.chain.* classes that no longer exist; ServiceLoader iteration throws for every classpath that contains either jar
B3 OpenID Federation verifyChain verifies statement i+1 with statement i's jwks (reverse of spec section 10.2), never signature-checks the leaf, and parse() accepts alg=none PlainJWT
B4 FileWallet.readRecord compares an absolute normalized path against Files.list output, so list/query/getStatistics throw for any relative or non-normalized storagePath (introduced by this diff)

B5 Verifiable Intent: L3 payment/checkout tokens are never checked for aud/nonce (reference implementation does); budget/recurrence counted as checked (TW-R13-01); negative or string-typed amounts pass (TW-R13-02)
B6 444 changed paths and 105 untracked ABI dumps are uncommitted with 5 commits unpushed; the release-evidence workflow cannot validate what is not in Git
needed_not_blocking: N1 CredentialFilter(revoked=...) now throws IllegalStateException from inside list()/query() on the first status-bearing credential; no factory accepts a WalletStatusResolver
N2 CloudWallet listing aborts on a concurrent delete or one corrupt object; statistics do N downloads; DatabaseWallet.getStatistics materialises every row with no LIMIT
N3 Status-list server returns e.message on public endpoints and swallows CancellationException (TW-R13-03)

N4 Plaintext-to-public-host gate covers EVM and Bitcoin only; Algorand, Cardano and Indy still send tokens over http://; hostnames with underscores are rejected; Bitcoin throws raw IllegalArgumentException where EVM wraps

N5 oidc4vp, SIOP and CHAPI session maps are unbounded; oidc4vci offer store hard-fails with an unchecked exception at 1000 offers; federation resolver follows every authority_hint with no breadth budget or cycle guard
N6 Observability unchanged: 35/777 files log; 648 broad catches; 6 empty catches

N7 26 modules with main code and no test source (cheqd, ens, ion, plc, polygon, sol, venafi, salesforce, servicenow, chapi, anchor, status-list database, both registrar servers, wallet-services, starknet, 9 example scenarios)

N8 Reference wallet (demo scope): claim-key extension written but never read by any verifier; consent defaults to no claims so the airspace gate denies valid holders; recovery export cannot be restored; reset fails in the environment that shows the recovery screen; passkey enrollment rejects synced authenticators after creating them
N9 docs-check.yml still uses mutable action tags; the module-name doc gate was removed; ScenarioExecutionTest wraps a cold quickStart in a 30 s timeout

N10 Deployment policy: TestkitWalletFactory ignores it, SUPPORTED_ONLY can construct no wallet because every catalogued plugin is experimental, and PluginRegistry rejects the ~98 uncatalogued modules with 'No assessed capabilities'
production_grade_already: Full test suite green when run: 3790 tests across 87 modules, 0 failures; wallet 70/70; ABI check passes
Binary-compatibility validation on every Kotlin module with a documented updateKotlinAbi procedure and CI gate
Remote Maven publication refuses to run without TRUSTWEAVE_SIGNING_KEY; per-module CycloneDX SBOM attached with the cyclonedx classifier
Release-evidence workflow with GitHub build-provenance attestation; ci.yml and release-evidence.yml pinned to action commit SHAs
TransportSecurity refuses plaintext to public hosts for EVM and Bitcoin, failing closed on DNS failure
KmsProviderConfig refuses in-memory key providers outside dev/test/local; wallet deployment policy exists and is tested for three plugins
Bounded, expiring exchange stores in oidc4vci; PKCE; SSRF guards on did:web and federation fetches; bounded response bodies
docs/api-reference/module-maturity.md tiers every module and states that publishing a JAR is not a production claim; release-validation.md documents ABI, SBOM and signing
recommended_sequence: Run ./gradlew ktlintFormat, fix the residue by hand, and get one green CI run on main so the ABI, coverage and SBOM steps execute for the first time (B1)
Fix the two service files and add a ServiceLoader smoke test over distribution:all (B2)
Rewrite TrustChainResolver.verifyChain in spec order, reject unsigned statements, and add a positive-path test with real keys (B3)
Normalise walletDir in FileWallet (or compare by file name) and add a relative-path test (B4)
Port expected_l3_*_aud/nonce from the reference implementation; split checked into locally-enforced vs acknowledged; reject negative and string amounts (B5)
Commit the ABI dumps with the code, push, tag, and run release-evidence once to obtain a verified attestation (B6)
Then N1-N5 in that order; N6-N10 as hygiene
method: Ran assemble, ktlintCheck, checkKotlinAbi and the full test task locally (--max-workers=3), plus tsc and vitest for the reference wallet. Fourteen review agents scanned the diff from complementary angles; every blocker and the load-bearing needed items were re-verified by reading the source, and B5 was checked against the Python reference implementation. Round-13 findings were re-checked in the tree.
limits: Nothing was deployed or load-tested; no fix was applied. Findings marked PLAUSIBLE in findings.json rest on agent evidence not independently reproduced. Reference-wallet defects are scored lightly because the README states it is not a production custody product. SaaS excluded.
